scope: CLI self-upgrade implemented, natively accepted and published in stable 0.2.3

behavior.default: Show current and latest stable versions, then confirm with y/yes; Enter or EOF cancels
behavior.downloads: Official GitHub stable release manager ZIP and SHA256SUMS; bounded downloads, SHA-256 and executable version verification before publication
behavior.publication: Current manager publishes the verified target version using existing ownership and journal recovery checks
behavior.configuration: Tool selections are retained; empty installation release follows target CLI
behavior.windows: Rename running CLI to journal-owned backup, publish candidate, restore old CLI on publication failure; clean retained backup on subsequent installation or recovery
